declarations.docstring: Associates an exponent vector indexed by `Fin N` to a partition.
Identifies the partition exponent vector with the corresponding auxiliary construction.
Expresses a signed auxiliary value as a coefficient of a multivariate polynomial.
The exponent vector assigning one to every index of `Fin N`.
The auxiliary multivariate polynomial associated with a permutation.
Relates the auxiliary permutation polynomial with equal ambient and permutation sizes to an auxiliary polynomial.
A ring homomorphism from polynomials in `Fin (N + 1)` variables to polynomials in `Fin N` variables.
The variable homomorphism sends each successor-indexed variable to its predecessor-indexed variable.
The variable homomorphism sends the zero-indexed variable to zero.
Applying the variable homomorphism to the auxiliary permutation polynomial lowers its ambient size.
The variable homomorphism preserves a positive power sum after lowering the ambient size.
Computes the image of an auxiliary polynomial under the variable homomorphism.
Computes a coefficient at the derived partition exponent vector after multiplication by the auxiliary permutation polynomial.
Specializes the coefficient computation to equal partition and ambient sizes.
Shows that the indicated coefficient is unchanged when the ambient size is increased by one.
Associates a derived exponent vector indexed by `Fin N` to a partition.
Describes the derived partition exponent vector using reversal, the partition exponent vector, and an auxiliary vector.
Describes the derived exponent vector at successor ambient size by consing zero and adding the all-one vector.
The monomial with the all-one exponent vector is the product of all variables.
Renaming variables by a permutation leaves the auxiliary permutation polynomial unchanged.
Renaming variables in the auxiliary polynomial scales it by the sign of the renaming permutation.
